text.en:
The powers and administrative supervision heretofore exercised by the Secretary of the Interior
over the assessment of real property, appropriation, and other financial affairs of provincial, municipal and
city governments and over the offices of provincial, municipal and city treasurers and provincial and city
assessors are hereby transferred to the Secretary of Finance.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 26, 1936.
